title: Marie Kruses Skole — claimed by thegentlemen
description: DK · Education · mks.dk Marie Kruses Skole is a private school in Farum, Denmark, founded in 1869 by education pioneer Marie Kruse, offering a full track from kindergarten through gymnasium STX to about 1100 students. It is the only free primary school and the only gymnasium in Furesø Kommune, employing 107 people and led by rektor Carsten Gade.
